author: Sweedie
body:
Age: I’m 13 right now but I’m turning 14 soon.

Timezone: GMT+1 (Sweden)

Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes

Do you have access to Skype? Yes

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes


CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?
No.


What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?

My biggest weakness is probably my english. Lack of grammar and spelling sometimes but I’m working on it. I could be misunderstood a few times but I think I can correct myself.

My biggest strength is probably that I can stay kind and positive and so am I most of the time. And I always tries to bring fun to people.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?

I think I can mostly just keep up with the activity but who knows, maybe I’ll get some nice ideas to improve the staff team when I see more than what the community sees.


What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?

A leader needs to be experienced, understanding, calm, active, respectful, creative and you have to take your time.


I don’t think I’m a leader yet. I’m not very experienced even though I can see the difference between a legit player and a hacker. I’m not very creative either. But I am calm, active, respectful and most of the times pretty understanding.


Experied: A leader needs to know what he/she is doing.
Understanding: You can’t constantly stay mad for a mistake, example.
Calm: It’ll be much easier and more comfortable to talk to you if you can stay calm.
Active: You need to know what’s going on and constantly thinking of solutions if problems appears or just new ideas.
Respectful: If you can respect everyone then you won’t be acting unfair and you will always listen for advice and new ideas from everyone.
Creative: You can figure out how to solve problems and come up with new ideas.

Taking your time: You won’t judge people too quick, you will most likely do the right choice sience you’ve been thinking more than twice and lot of stuff will go according to plans.


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

I’m calm and active, I can see the difference between legit players and hackers. I’m kind towards others and stay positive. I’m not too quick in decisions nor am I complaining about things that doesn’t run very smooth.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

I think you need to stay calm and you should keep yourself from swearing and being able to ’hold a straight face’ sometimes. Talking properly instead of using slurls is very useful so you’re understood.

I can do that.


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)?

Something between 2-7h per day I think. Depends on which day it is and of course this is with some exceptions.


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?

I woud record him and then freeze him. Then I would ask a moderator to ban him when they can.


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?

I would secretly record the staff member and ask him/her to leave too. If I’m right the rules does not apply in the teamchannels and I therefore can’t punish the staff member but I would suggest the players to mute the staff member (with ”Mute Client”). I would give the evidence to a senior moderator and request him to talk with the staff member. I think he/she needs a change in his/her attitude science the staff team should be a good example.


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?

Depends on the punishment. If the player hasn’t been following the chat rules I would look it up in the chat history (if I can or anyone with a higher rank can. Otherweis I would just bring up the conversation). If the player was hacking I would probably ask for some advice in the moderator chat. But for now I would probably try to remember some wittnesses (If I’m able to check reports from the past it would be easy to find some.) or check if there’s any reports at the forums, just if anyone else might have recorded this player too.


You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

First time I would just take a screenshot and ask if he/she could remove his/her post. If the staff member keeps posting this kind of content I would report him/her to a senior moderator for leaking.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?

I would talk to one of the seniors and ask for more details and tell him why I don’t like the decision and if I can figure out any better solution I would request that instead.


CRITERIA 3: OTHER


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?

I’m unsure. I think it means more responsibilities to help the server for me. I would also join the team that makes Avicus grow then and I would always do my best to help out.


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?

Avicus means quite a lot to me becouse I like the gamemodes, community and I’ve made a lot of friends here. So I’m very passionate.


Do you speak any other languages than English?

Yes, I speak Swedish and I’m learning German.



Thank you for reading!
